definitions: The male head of a family or tribal line.
Any of those biblical figures regarded as fathers of the human race, e.g., Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
A bishop of the highest rank in certain Eastern Christian Churches.
An old man who is respected for his wisdom and experience.
examples: He was the patriarch of a large and influential family.
The story of the patriarchs is central to the Old Testament.
The Ecumenical Patriarch resides in Istanbul.
The village patriarch offered sage advice.
